definitions.gloss: sure enough; as expected; just as one thought
definitions.explanation: Used when something happens exactly as one predicted or worried it would, often with slightly negative expectations.

examples.japanese: {案|あん}の{定|じょう}、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧。
examples.english: Sure enough, I missed the train.

examples.japanese: {案|あん}の{定|じょう}、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: As expected, he had forgotten the promise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り→降る：00839_furu⟧そうだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}ったら→思う：00492_omou⟧、{案|あん}の{定|じょう}⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた。
examples.english: I thought it looked like rain, and sure enough, it started raining.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (plan, expectation) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive) + {定|じょう} (fixed, determined)
Literally: "as the expectation was fixed" → "just as expected"

USAGE:
Typically used when a negative or undesirable outcome that was anticipated actually occurs. Less commonly used for positive surprises.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やはり→やはり：01991_yahari⟧/⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧ - as expected (more neutral, can be positive or negative)
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ - just as I thought
- ⟦{予想|よそう}{通|どお}り→予想通り：16795_yosoudoori⟧ - as predicted
- {果|は}たして - as expected, sure enough (more literary)
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - unexpectedly
- ⟦{思|おも}いのほか→思いのほか：07860_omoinohoka⟧ - more than expected
